verdict.rationale: DBOS documents unit-testing workflows and steps with pytest or unittest, and running a self-hosted Conductor and Console locally via Docker Compose. Because it needs nothing but Postgres, a separate local database can serve as an isolated test environment. However, nothing in the evidence describes a first-class sandbox or staging environment, or any guarantee that keeps tests from touching production data. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test-environment feature, documented separation of test and production databases or credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration.
